title: dream-num/univer
lede: Univer is the Apache-2.0 core of a TypeScript Office SDK: embeddable spreadsheet and document editing, a formula engine and Facade APIs that both applications and agents can drive.

points: The repo holds the Web SDK: content models, snapshot format, plugin system, command and undo system, formula and rendering engines, and Sheets and Docs editing.
The Server SDK (collaboration, edit history, file import and export) and AI SDK extensions are commercial and licensed separately.
Facade APIs let code or an agent write ranges, change values and read recalculated formulas in the same workbook the user sees.
Content models and commands also run headless in Node.js for automated edits without an editor.
Features are split into logic plugins and UI plugins, composed through presets or registered by hand.

points.text: Clipboard fidelity with Excel: pasted numbers lose their formatting.
Docs users want bookmarks plus .docx import and export.
Right-to-left scripts such as Arabic are a high-priority rendering gap.
Lifecycle bugs: errors appear when an instance is destroyed and created again.
